guide.changmin_villager_turret.received: [Villager Turret] You received the guide book! Check your inventory.
guide.changmin_villager_turret.page1:
§lVillager Turret Guide§r

Place turrets to defend your village from the zombie horde.

1. Getting Started
2. Turret Types
3. Tokens & Upgrades
4. The Zombie Tribe
5. Tips
guide.changmin_villager_turret.page2:
§l1. Getting Started§r

Place 3 wooden planks vertically to craft a §6Shopkeeper Villager Spawn Egg§r.

Buy turret spawn eggs from the shopkeeper and right-click the ground to place a turret.
guide.changmin_villager_turret.page3:
§l2. Turret Types (1)§r

§2Villager Turret§r
 Auto-fires arrows
§3Trident Turret§r
 Piercing tridents
§6Tanker Turret§r
 Taunts zombies
§dHealing Totem§r
 Heals allies & players
guide.changmin_villager_turret.page4:
§l2. Turret Types (2)§r

§5Lightning Wizard§r
 Stun bolts + storm
§9Plasma Wizard§r
 Powerful plasma orbs
§eBee Summoner§r
 Summons bees

Resource Villagers do not fight; they produce resources.
guide.changmin_villager_turret.page5:
§l3. Tokens & Upgrades§r

Turrets gain XP by killing zombies and drop a §6Low-grade Token§r on level up.

Right-click a turret to open its upgrade screen.
guide.changmin_villager_turret.page6:
§l3. Token Exchange§r

Each turret type has its own tokens.

Exchange at the shopkeeper:
 9 Low → 1 Mid
 3 Mid → 1 High

The Zombie Boss drops Mid-grade Villager Turret tokens.
guide.changmin_villager_turret.page7:
§l4. The Zombie Tribe§r

Turrets attack vanilla zombies and this mod's zombies.

§cHealer Zombies§r and §cZombie Commanders§r support other zombies, so turrets target them first.
guide.changmin_villager_turret.page8:
§l5. Tips§r

§6★§r above a turret:
 you can afford an upgrade with your tokens

Hold a spawn egg, or sneak while looking at a turret, to see its range on the ground.
guide.changmin_villager_turret.page9:
§l5. Tips (2)§r

Hover over an item and hold §eShift§r for details.

Check your progress in Advancements (L key).

Good luck!
